meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 当你要设置或检查云同步时,Claude 会查询当前同步状态,或向你索取令牌、用户 ID 和 Hub 地址并写入配置,重启后验证连接,最后报告结果。
howto.when: 当你说出‘设置云同步’、‘同步我的记忆’、‘cmem pro’等关键词,或要求把记忆数据库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.note: Claude 会查询并报告当前同步进度和连接是否正常。

say.text: 把我的记忆同步到 cmem.ai
say.note: 会引导你完成连接设置并验证同步。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude checks sync status or asks for your token, user ID and Hub URL, saves them, restarts the worker, verifies the connection, and reports the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'set up cloud sync', 'sync my memories', 'cmem pro', etc., or ask to back up/sync your memory database to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for your token, user ID, and Hub URL.
Claude will check and report sync progress and connection.
Guides you through connection setup and verifies sync.
